notes.title: 0. 12 Fishing and QOL updates
notes.content:
Fishing bug has been fixed.

Some items have been redesigned.

World owners now display differently:

Yellow username for world owner.

Light green username for accessed players.

Players’ world info menu now shows:

World name

Owner name


Shop now has categories for better organization.

Added UI for player profiles do /playerinfo (name).

Some text colors have been updated for readability.

Pause menu / world info menu displays dynamic world ownership info.
fixed ui bug

- fixed up ui color
- fixed bug that made game freeze when closing
- minor tweek to player movment
- fixed wings not de equiping
- fixed much more

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixed many bugs and improved performance.

Resolved an issue where the game would freeze during crashes or when closing.

⚠️ Known Issue: In rare cases, the game may still freeze during loading screens. We're continuing to investigate this.

notes.title: 0.10 Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixed many bugs and improved overall stability.

⚠️ Known Issue: The game may still freeze when closing or during certain loading screens. We're actively investigating this and will release a fix as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience!
